name: Vivus Glomerorum
source:
Considered highly dangerous, subject VG-71122 demonstrates extreme adaptive intelligence and cunning. It seems to refine its behavior in direct response to your presence.

Whether it intends to harm or simply understand you is still unclear.

What answers will you find?
